Issue Title: [BUG] SlidingWindowConversationManager.reduce_context fails to trim tool-heavy conversations after v1.35.0

Description:
### Checks

- [x] I have updated to the lastest minor and patch version of Strands
- [x] I have checked the documentation and this is not expected behavior
- [x] I have searched [./issues](./issues?q=) and there are no duplicates of my issue

### Strands Version

1.35.0

### Python Version

3.11

### Operating System

Linux

### Installation Method

pip

### Steps to Reproduce

```
from strands.agent.conversation_manager import SlidingWindowConversationManager
from strands.types.exceptions import ContextWindowOverflowException
from unittest.mock import MagicMock

manager = SlidingWindowConversationManager(window_size=4)

agent = MagicMock()
agent.messages = [
    {"role": "user", "content": [{"text": "Review this PR"}]},
    {"role": "assistant", "content": [{"toolUse": {"toolUseId": "1", "name": "get_diff", "input": {}}}]},
    {"role": "user", "content": [{"toolResult": {"toolUseId": "1", "content": [{"text": "diff data"}], "status": "success"}}]},
    {"role": "assistant", "content": [{"toolUse": {"toolUseId": "2", "name": "get_file", "input": {}}}]},
    {"role": "user", "content": [{"toolResult": {"toolUseId": "2", "content": [{"text": "file data"}], "status": "success"}}]},
    {"role": "assistant", "content": [{"toolUse": {"toolUseId": "3", "name": "get_tree", "input": {}}}]},
    {"role": "user", "content": [{"toolResult": {"toolUseId": "3", "content": [{"text": "tree data"}], "status": "success"}}]},
    {"role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "Here is my review"}]},
]

manager.reduce_context(agent, e=Exception("context window overflow"))
```

### Expected Behavior

reduce_context should successfully trim the conversation, as it did in v1.34.1 (which trims to 3 messages for this input).

### Actual Behavior

reduce_context raises ContextWindowOverflowException: Unable to trim conversation context!

The user-first enforcement added in PR#2087 skips all assistant messages as trim points. Combined with the existing toolResult check that skips user messages containing tool results, there are no valid trim points in tool-heavy conversations:

user (prompt)           ← only plain user message, but before trim window
assistant (tool call)   ← skipped: not a user message
user (tool result)      ← skipped: contains toolResult
assistant (tool call)   ← skipped: not a user message
user (tool result)      ← skipped: contains toolResult
assistant (tool call)   ← skipped: not a user message
user (tool result)      ← skipped: contains toolResult
assistant (response)    ← skipped: not a user message

### Additional Context

_No response_

### Possible Solution

When no plain user message exists within the trim range, fall back to trimming at an assistant(toolUse) + user(toolResult) boundary. This preserves the user-first fix for providers like Bedrock Nova (no bare assistant messages) while still allowing trimming in tool-heavy conversations. The conversation would start with a valid complete tool interaction pair.

https://github.com/strands-agents/sdk-python/issues/2085
